# Load data

```{r}
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/CA_LTACH_first_clinical_per_quarter_CRKP_genomes_merged_studies_metadata.RDS")  
``` 

```{r}
df_w_metadata <- df %>% subset(has_full_metadata==T & first_isolate==T) 
df_w_metadata$non_hispanic_white <- df_w_metadata$participant_race=="Caucasian" & df_w_metadata$participant_ethnicity == "Not Hispanic"
```

# Create table

```{r}
table <-  convert_tableone_into_df(dataset = df_w_metadata, vars = c("participant_age_at_first_enc","participant_sex","participant_race","non_hispanic_white",'source_simplified',"los_before_culture",'hospital_location_recode'), factorVars = c("participant_sex","participant_race","non_hispanic_white",'source_simplified','hospital_location_recode'),strata='study',outcome_names = c("2014-15","2021-23"),exact = c("source_simplified","hospital_location_recode"),argsExact = list(simulate.p.value=T),nonnormal_vars =c( 'participant_age_at_first_enc','los_before_culture'),addOverall=T)

table$Variable <- recode(table$Variable,
                         "participant_age_at_first_enc (median [IQR])" = "Age in years, median (IQR)",
                         "participant_sex = male (%)" = "Male sex",
                         "participant_race (%)" = "Race",
                         "participant_ethnicity = Not Hispanic (%)"= "Non-Hispanic White",
                         "source_simplified (%)" = "Site of infection",
                         "   blood" = '   Blood',
                         '   other'='   Other',
                         '   urine'='   Urine',
                         '   respiratory'='   Respiratory',
                         '   wound'='   Wound',
                         "   more than one race"="   More than one race",
                         "non_hispanic_white = TRUE (%)" = "Non-Hispanic white",
                         "los_before_culture (median [IQR])" = "Length of stay before culture, median [IQR]",
                         "hospital_location_recode (%)" = "Long-term acute care hospital (LTACH)")

table  
```

# Validate p-value for site and LTACH

```{r}
# Source of infection
source_table <- table(df_w_metadata$source_simplified,df_w_metadata$study)
source_table
source_table_pvalue <- fisher.test(source_table,simulate.p.value = T)
source_table_pvalue

# LTACH
ltach_overall_table <-  table(df_w_metadata$hospital_location_recode,df_w_metadata$study)
ltach_overall_table
ltach_overall_table_pvalue <-  fisher.test(ltach_overall_table,simulate.p.value = T)
ltach_overall_table_pvalue$p.value

## Shared
ltach_shared_table <- ltach_overall_table[rownames(ltach_overall_table) != 'LTACH 6',]
ltach_shared_table
ltach_shared_table_pvalue <-  fisher.test(ltach_shared_table,simulate.p.value = T)
ltach_shared_table_pvalue$p.value
```

```{r}
table$`P-value` <- ifelse(table$Variable == "Long-term acute care hospital (LTACH)","-",table$`P-value`)
table[table=="0 (NaN)"] <- "-"  
```

```{r}
table   %>% favorite_kable
```

```{r}
saveRDS(table,"./tables/s_table_3_demographics.RDS")
write_csv(table,"./tables/s_table_3_demographics.csv")
```
